# Halora Works

Halora Works develops BranchWatch, an automated drone system designed for electric grid maintenance firms to streamline overhead line inspections. BranchWatch combines high-resolution imaging with advanced vegetation encroachment analytics to identify outage risks posed by overgrown trees and foliage near power lines. 

In 2023, Halora Works completed over 15,000 successful line inspections across three regional utility providers, reducing manual survey times by 60%. The company recently secured $8 million in Series A funding led by Riverbank Ventures to expand operational capacity and enhance AI models.

The core team includes CEO Xanrel Corbett, CTO Rajiv Menon, and Head of Field Ops Jortun Suarez, with expertise in robotics, geospatial analytics, and utility workflows. Main competitors are GridScope Drones and VerdantEye Tech, both focused on aerial inspection but lacking BranchWatch’s integrated vegetation risk scoring.

Open risks include regulatory approvals for drone flights in new states and ensuring data privacy compliance with evolving utility standards.
